commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking

echo "Running mypy type checks..."

# Run mypy on all Python files in src/
mypy src/

# Check if mypy passed
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "✓ Type checking passed!"
    exit 0
else
    echo "✗ Type checking failed - commit blocked"
    exit 1
fi
EOF
ls -la .git/hooks/pre-commit
